name.zh: 區域全面經濟夥伴協定

headquarters.en: RCEP Support Unit hosted by the ASEAN Secretariat, Jakarta, Indonesia
headquarters.zh: RCEP支援單位設於東協秘書處（印尼雅加達）

nature.en: Mega free trade agreement (treaty) among ASEAN and five partners; signed 15 Nov 2020, in force 1 Jan 2022
nature.zh: 東協與五個夥伴國簽署的大型自由貿易協定（條約）；2020年11月15日簽署，2022年1月1日生效

purpose.en: The world's largest free trade agreement by GDP and population: cuts tariffs, harmonizes rules of origin and facilitates trade and investment across East Asia and Oceania.
purpose.zh: 以GDP與人口計算全球最大的自由貿易協定：降低關稅、統一原產地規則，促進東亞與大洋洲的貿易與投資。

members.note: Entry into force for Myanmar (1 May 2022) is contested by some parties following the 2021 coup.
Applied Jan 2022. Accession working group agreed at the 5th RCEP Ministers' Meeting (Manila, Sep 2026).
Applied 2023. Accession working group agreed at the 5th RCEP Ministers' Meeting (Manila, Sep 2026).
Applied 2024. Accession working group agreed at the 5th RCEP Ministers' Meeting (Manila, Sep 2026).
Applied 2025. Accession working group agreed at the 5th RCEP Ministers' Meeting (Manila, Sep 2026).

notes: 15 parties (10 ASEAN members as of 2020 + China, Japan, Republic of Korea, Australia, New Zealand). Timor-Leste, ASEAN's 11th member since Oct 2025, is NOT an RCEP party.
India took part in negotiations but withdrew in 2019; it may rejoin under special provisions but has not applied.

Accession: Hong Kong, Sri Lanka, Chile and Bangladesh applied; at the 5th RCEP Ministers' Meeting (Manila, concluded 21 Sep 2026) ministers agreed to establish accession working groups for all four (CGTN, 2 Oct 2026). Marked 'acceding'. No new party admitted as of 2026-11-16.
Application years for acceding economies are approximate (from news reports).
